svg.title: ai-tools identities: the operators, the sandbox account, root, and their groups
svg.desc: Operators op and svc-ci each hold ai-ops membership, a name in OPERATORS and their own allowlist; op also holds a general sudo grant. The ai-tools sandbox account runs every session and is not in ai-ops; root is not an operator. The operators group carries the two sudo rules; the sandbox group is how the coding agent reaches the files you write; your own group takes your secret-named files.
